title: Gupshup
short_description: Messaging infrastructure platform for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: Gupshup is a conversational messaging platform that enables organisations to build and deploy communication workflows across channels such as WhatsApp, SMS, and other messaging services.

title: Hive
short_description: Workflow coordination and project tracking for nonprofits
long_description: Hive is a workflow and project management platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations organise tasks, track progress, and coordinate workflows across teams. It brings together task management, timelines, and communication into a single workspace, supporting structured execution of programmes and internal processes.

title: Hootsuite
short_description: Flexible social media management for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Hootsuite is a social media management platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations plan content, manage engagement, monitor public conversations, and analyse performance across multiple platforms from a single dashboard.

title: Hotjar
short_description: User behaviour analytics tool for website and user experience
long_description:
Hotjar is a digital experience analytics tool (now part of Contentsquare) that helps organisations understand how users interact with their websites and applications. It provides visual insights into user behaviour through heatmaps, session recordings, and feedback tools.

It enables teams to move beyond quantitative metrics and understand user behaviour, friction points, and engagement patterns.

title: HubSpot
short_description: CRM and engagement platform for managing donor communication and outreach.
long_description: HubSpot provides tools for customer relationship management (CRM), marketing, sales, and communication, enabling organisations to manage contacts and engagement within a single system.

title: IBM Cloud
short_description: Enterprise cloud platform for secure and compliant infrastructure, AI, and hybrid cloud systems.
long_description: IBM Cloud is a hybrid‑first cloud platform leveraging IBM’s global data centers and AI heritage. It offers a range of services including virtual servers, Kubernetes, AI/Watson, and blockchain tools.

title: Instagram
short_description: Digital storytelling and engagement platform for nonprofits and SPOs
long_description:
Instagram is a widely used social media platform that enables nonprofits and social purpose organisations to communicate their work through visual storytelling, short-form video, and real-time updates.
It is used to build visibility, engage supporters, and translate programme work into accessible, ongoing public narratives.

title: Jasper
short_description: An AI content generation platform designed for teams to create long-form and marketing content.
long_description: Jasper is an AI writing assistant that helps users generate content for various purposes, including marketing copy, blog articles, and social media posts. It uses artificial intelligence to create human-like text quickly and efficiently.

title: Jira
short_description: Software project tracking for nonprofits
long_description: Jira is a widely used issue tracking and project management software, primarily developed for agile teams. It helps teams plan, track, and manage work and can be adapted for nonprofit organisations managing programmes, operations, and field activities.

title: Jitsi Meet
short_description: Flexible video meetings for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: Jitsi Meet is a free, open-source video conferencing platform used by nonprofits and social purpose organisations to conduct online meetings, training sessions, and remote collaboration. It works directly in a browser, requires no account, and supports secure communication across distributed teams.

title: Joomla
short_description: Open-source content management system for NGO websites
long_description: Joomla is a free, open-source content management system (CMS) that helps organisations build and manage websites without deep coding knowledge. It provides structured content management, user access control, and extensions to expand functionality.

title: Jotform
short_description: Simple forms for NGOs & SPOs
long_description: Jotform is a no-code form builder used by nonprofits and social purpose organisations to create digital forms for registrations, surveys, and basic data collection workflows. It enables teams to collect and organise data without technical expertise.

title: Journeys of Change
short_description: Learning journey and outcome tracking platform for nonprofits
long_description: Journeys of Change is a programme design platform that helps nonprofits structure fellowship and capacity-building programmes as learning journeys, track participant progression across milestones, and link activities to measurable outcomes.

title: Keka HR
short_description: HR, payroll, and workforce management system for nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: Keka HR is a cloud-based Human Resource Management System (HRMS) that enables organisations to manage payroll, attendance, recruitment, performance, and employee records within a single platform. It is designed to automate the full employee lifecycle while supporting statutory compliance and workforce management at scale.

title: Kelsa
short_description: HR workflow platform for employee lifecycle and people processes
long_description: Kelsa is a no-code HR workflow and process management platform that helps organisations design, automate, and monitor people-related operations. It enables teams to streamline HR processes such as employee onboarding, leave approvals, performance workflows, and internal requests reducing manual coordination and improving visibility across the employee lifecycle.

title: KoboToolbox
short_description: Open-Source Field Data Collection & M&E Platform for Humanitarian and Development Organisations.
long_description: KoboToolbox is a free, open-source data collection platform developed by the Harvard Humanitarian Initiative, widely used by nonprofits, humanitarian agencies, governments, and researchers to collect field data, conduct surveys, and manage monitoring and evaluation (M&E) workflows, even in low-connectivity environments.

title: Later
short_description: Social media scheduling and content planning
long_description: Later is a social media management platform that helps plan, schedule, and publish content across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Twitter. It enables teams to organise content visually, automate posting, and maintain consistent communication with their audience.

title: Looker Studio
short_description: Lightweight dashboarding tool for real-time data visualisation using Google tools.
long_description: Looker Studio, previously known as Google Data Studio, is a free, web-based tool designed for data visualization and business intelligence. It empowers users to build interactive dashboards and reports by connecting to a wide array of data sources.

title: Lovable AI
short_description: AI-assisted app building and prototyping for nonprofits
long_description: Lovable AI is an AI-assisted platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations build simple applications, tools, and workflows with minimal coding. It enables teams to create early-stage prototypes using natural language prompts, supporting faster experimentation and iteration.

title: M-Files
short_description: Document management system for organising and controlling organisational information in nonprofits and social purpose organisations
long_description: M-Files is a document management system that enables organisations to organise, manage, and control documents and information. It uses a metadata-based approach, allowing documents to be classified and retrieved based on attributes such as project, donor, or document type rather than folder structures.

title: Magento
short_description: E-commerce platform for online fundraising and merchandise
long_description: Magento (Adobe Commerce) is an open-source e-commerce platform that enables organisations to build and manage online stores with advanced customisation and scalability. It supports product management, payments, customer accounts, and integrations for large-scale online operations.

title: Mailchimp
short_description: Email marketing and outreach platform for donor and supporter communication
long_description: Mailchimp enables organisations to run structured email outreach campaigns with targeted and automated communication. It also provides analytics to track engagement and measure campaign performance.

title: Make
short_description: Workflow automation and integration for nonprofits.
long_description: Make is a no-code workflow automation platform that connects apps, systems, and data to automate repetitive operational tasks. It streamlines processes across CRM, finance, communications, and project management, improving efficiency while reducing manual workload.

title: MarketMuse
short_description: Content optimisation and planning support for NGOs and social purpose organisations.
long_description: MarketMuse is an AI-powered content intelligence platform that helps businesses plan, create, and optimize content strategies. It provides insights into content performance, identifies content gaps, and suggests topics to improve search visibility.

title: Medallia
short_description: Feedback and experience management for nonprofits
long_description: Medallia is a feedback and experience management platform that helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations collect, analyse, and act on feedback from beneficiaries, donors, staff, and partners. It supports organisations in understanding experiences across programmes and services to inform improvements.

title: Meritto
short_description: Student recruitment and enrolment platform for nonprofits & social purpose organisations
long_description: Meritto is an AI‑powered operating system for student recruitment and enrollment, offering modules like Enrollment Cloud, Education CRM, Application Platform, and Payment Cloud to streamline admissions and fee collection for educational institutions.

title: Meshy AI
short_description: AI-powered 3D model generation for NGOs and SPOs.
long_description: Meshy AI is an AI-powered platform that enables users to generate and edit 3D models from text or images, supporting visual content creation for communication, learning, and digital use.

title: Meta AI
short_description: AI assistant and content support for nonprofits
long_description: Meta AI is an artificial intelligence assistant developed by Meta that helps organisations generate content, answer queries, and assist with everyday tasks. It is integrated into platforms such as WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook, allowing teams to use AI within tools they already use for communication and outreach.

title: Microsoft Azure
short_description: Platform for managing apps, data, and infrastructure across cloud environments.
long_description: Microsoft Azure is a cloud platform that helps organisations manage applications, data, and infrastructure across cloud and on-premise systems. It brings together services like storage, analytics, AI, and security in one place, making it easier to run and scale digital operations. For nonprofits, it simplifies data management, supports programme delivery, and reduces dependence on complex local IT setups.

title: Microsoft Copilot
short_description: AI assistant for productivity and document workflows in nonprofits
long_description: Microsoft’s Microsoft Copilot is an AI assistant integrated into Microsoft tools such as Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams. It helps nonprofits and social purpose organisations generate content, analyse data, summarise information, and support everyday workflows within familiar applications.

title: Microsoft Dynamics 365
short_description: ERP, CRM & Enterprise Operations Platform
long_description:
Microsoft Dynamics 365 is a cloud-based suite of business applications designed for enterprise resource planning (ERP), customer relationship management (CRM), finance, operations, reporting, and workflow coordination.

The platform combines business applications, analytics, automation, and operational management tools within a connected enterprise software ecosystem.

title: Microsoft Excel
short_description: Spreadsheet tool for data management, analysis, and reporting
long_description:
Microsoft Excel is a spreadsheet application developed by Microsoft that enables organisations to organise, analyse, and manage data using tables, formulas, and visualisations.

It is widely used for data entry, calculations, reporting, and basic analytics, making it a foundational tool for programme and operational data management.

title: Microsoft Power BI
short_description: Data visualisation and business intelligence for nonprofits & SPOs
long_description: Microsoft Power BI is a data visualisation and business intelligence tool developed by Microsoft that enables organisations to connect data sources, build interactive dashboards, and generate insights for reporting and decision-making.

title: Midjourney
short_description: Midjourney creates stylised images from text prompts for campaigns and creative use.
long_description: Midjourney is an AI-based image generation platform that creates visuals from text prompts. It is used to generate stylised images for creative work, campaigns, and digital communication.

title: Milaap
short_description: Crowdfunding platform for fundraising
long_description: Milaap is a crowdfunding platform that enables individuals and nonprofit organisations to raise funds online by creating campaigns and reaching donors through the platform. It combines campaign creation, payment collection, and donor discovery in a single system.

title: MindsDB
short_description: Machine learning integration for data-driven nonprofits
long_description: MindsDB is a machine learning platform that enables nonprofits and social purpose organisations to build predictive models using their existing data. It integrates with databases and data sources, allowing teams to generate predictions directly from their data without building full machine learning systems.

title: Monday.com
short_description: work management platform for nonprofits
long_description: Monday.com is a cloud-based work operating system that helps organisations manage workflows, projects, and collaboration in one place.

title: MongoDB
short_description: AI-Ready Data Platform for Modern Applications
long_description: MongoDB is a document database platform used by organisations to build scalable applications, manage operational data, and support AI-enabled workflows across cloud and self-managed environments.
